environment_intro: Cleared installs what each service needs once, so that sessions start in seconds.
environment_no_devcontainer: No .devcontainer: built on the session image of Cleared.
environment_foreign_image: {image} is not Cleared's session image: a session needs Node 24, Claude Code and Cleared's runner in it, or it cannot start.
environment_summary_building: Installing, usually a few minutes. You can leave this page.
environment_note: A merge that changes a lock file, the install command or the .devcontainer installs again. Each build reads the base branch only.
environment_error_invalid_workspace: The workspace file cannot be read. The checks step says why.
environment_error_other: The build could not start. Try again in a moment.
environment_check_output: The last lines of the check of {service}
environment_session_title: Prepare the environment of the {service} service
environment_session_restart: Restart Cleared so it sees this service, then come back here.
environment_error_no_flow: Cleared does not run tickets yet: restart it with this workspace, then try again.
environment_error_restart: Cleared read the workspace before this service was connected: restart it, then try again.
environment_error_unknown_service: This service is not in the workspace any more. Read the page again.
environment_error_invalid: The setup session could not be made from this page. Read the page again.
environment_stale: The project changed since the last install.
environment_failed: The install failed. A session can look into it and fix it on a branch.
environment_check_none_installed: The tests fail because nothing is installed: this service does not say how to install what it needs. A session can set that up.
environment_check_missing: The tests fail because a tool is missing from the environment. A session can add it.
environment_check_other: The tests fail in this environment. A session can look into it.
environment_session_doing: A session is setting up {service}. Its work is reviewed before it lands.
environment_detail_check_none: None declared ([session] test_command, or a test script in package.json).
environment_detail_proposal: If the tests need more than the session image, a setup session writes its .devcontainer.
